title: Yellowed Buttery Roman Mozzarella Pinsa
description: A buttery, pillowy, romantic Italian dish featuring mozzarella, salt-bake, and vegetarian-friendly ingredients in a pinsa form, served on a tagliere vessel.
instructions: Combine flour, water, salt, sugar, and yeast in a large mixing bowl to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit with a baking stone inside.
Punch down the dough and shape it into a pinsa form, about 1/2 inch thick.
Place the pinsa on the preheated baking stone and bake for 15 minutes, or until it is lightly yellowed.
Remove the pinsa from the oven and brush it with melted butter.
Top the pinsa with sliced mozzarella cheese and return it to the oven for an additional 5 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the pinsa from the oven and drizzle it with extra virgin olive oil.
Sprinkle chopped fresh basil leaves over the pinsa and serve immediately on a tagliere vessel.
